Direct print sales copy:
Direct Print — the order goes to the kitchen without anyone having to shout

As soon as the order is placed, it prints automatically in the kitchen or at the bar — no waiter leaving their station, no handwritten tickets, no lost orders.

Fewer mistakes, less rushing, faster service.
Learn more direct print how it works:
Every new order prints a ticket in each station — kitchen, bar, or wherever you need it.

Once the ticket comes out, the team already knows what to prepare. You can also use it to send the order straight to the customer.

Less hassle and more speed.

Your waiter becomes a selling waiter: more attentive to what the guest wants, with more time to explain the best dishes, the best drinks, and deliver a better experience.

No more time wasted walking to the kitchen just to drop off orders.

You get more tables served with the same team. And guests are happier with that extra time the waiter now has.
Direct waiter sales copy:
Direct Garçom — this is our favorite 🤩

You put the NeuraBar Tag on the table and that's it: guests start ordering straight from the system, without calling anyone.

You know when they just want another drink and already know what they want? With DIRECT, they place the order themselves in seconds — no waiting, no fuss. You save time, your waiter gets a break, and the guest leaves happy.
Learn more direct waiter customer access:
Guests access it through the NeuraBar Tag on every table.

They hold the phone close and order in their own words — simple text like:
• "I'd like a coke with lemon and ice"
• "Can you bring a glass with ice?"

No app to download. No need to call anyone.
Learn more direct waiter order flow:
The order arrives in the kitchen with the text the guest typed, plus the table and the time.

That simple.
Learn more direct waiter advantage:
This is where our system starts.

Just by placing NeuraBar Tags on each table or spot, you already gain speed in service.

The guest orders quickly, the order arrives quickly, and the waiter is free for other tables.

We have a client using this at a pay-to-fish lake — and another even in a hotel. Because it is simple and fast.
Learn more direct waiter savings copy: Guests order on their own through the Tag. Waiters no longer walk back and forth just to take the order — and the team spends more time on the floor.

Financial dashboard sales copy:
Financial Dashboard — everything that happened in your venue, in one place

How many tables were served, what sold the most, what guests always order, how last month went, how last year went — all recorded and easy to see.

With this data in hand, you start making decisions with more confidence. For example: if November is going well, you can already compare with last year's November and get ready for an even better December.

No more guessing. Here, you know.
Learn more financial dashboard advantage:
No spreadsheets. No wasted time.

You see live how sales are going in your venue.

With the data in hand, in real time, it is easy to make decisions and build your plan.
Fiscal note sales copy:
Fiscal Note — issue it without leaving the system

When closing the check, you issue the fiscal receipt straight from NeuraBar — with or without the customer's CPF/CNPJ, in seconds.

Need a full invoice (DANFE) for a supplier or another purpose? That's here too. Everything in the same place, without opening another program, without the hassle.
Voice command sales copy:
Voice Commands — your waiter only needs their voice and a phone

No typing, no paper, no waiting. They speak, and the order is already on its way to the kitchen.

"Orange juice, table 4, glass with ice."
"Table 5, one more Brahma."
"A glass at table 3."
"Fries for table 7."

That's it. It got there. Just right.

Your waiter becomes a playmaker — calling out orders on the phone while still on the floor, without stopping service for a second.
Learn more voice command how it works:
Your system gains another feature, where your waiter can choose to place an order by voice.

They place the orders:
"Table 5, a glass with lemon and ice"
"Table 7, large fries with cheese"

Then they check on the phone that everything looks right
and they can correct it whenever they want
Learn more voice command advantage:
Besides the agility you gain in this mode

Your system can be used by people who are not familiar with systems

Your uncle can show up, help in the rush, and handle the orders
Production dashboard sales copy:
Kitchen Display — your customers will want to keep watching

You know those boards you see in fast-food chains, where every order comes in and goes out in real time? Now you have the same thing in your bar.

Put it in sight and let it run — your customers stay glued to all the orders coming in and going out. It creates that feeling of movement, of a packed house, of a business that really works.
Learn more production dashboard how it w:
As soon as an order is placed — by the customer or the waiter — it appears automatically on the restaurant monitor.

Each order stays visible with the table number and the order number. Everyone follows along in real time, without having to ask anyone anything.
Learn more production dashboard advantag:
A customer who sees their own order on the screen does not keep calling the waiter every five minutes. They know it arrived, they know it is being prepared, and they relax.

Less nagging, less rushing, more trust in your place.
Taker sales copy:
Orders on the Phone — your waiter takes the order at the table and it already goes to the kitchen

No more walking back and forth. With the phone in hand, your waiter opens the menu, takes the order on the spot, and that's it — it already reached the kitchen.

Fast, simple, no mistakes.
Learn more taker how it works: Your waiter opens NeuraBar on the phone, selects the table, picks the menu items, and confirms. In seconds the order is already in the kitchen — without them leaving their spot.
Learn more taker advantage: More time on the floor, fewer unnecessary trips. Your waiter serves more tables, the guest waits less, and the order arrives right — no noise, no rework.
Kds sales copy:
KDS — Every order on the right monitor, in the right place

As soon as an order comes in, it already appears on the monitor of the responsible station — kitchen, bar, grill, wherever. Each team sees only what is theirs, with no mix-up.

On the screen: the order, the table, and how long it has been waiting. Nobody needs to ask anything — just look and do it.
Learn more kds how it works:
The system identifies each order item and automatically sends it to the right monitor.

A drink goes to the bar, a picanha goes to the grill, an appetizer goes to the kitchen — everything separated, everything in its place.
Learn more kds advantage: Less shouting, fewer slips of paper, fewer mistakes. Each station works at its own pace without getting in the way of the other — and the guest gets everything right, at the right time.
Menu sales copy:
Digital Menu — your storefront open 24 hours

Build your menu with photo, description, and price. Set sizes, allow ingredient swaps, create combos — all the way your business works.

- The Digital Menu is complimentary for anyone who subscribes to the KDS, Take Order, or Delivery module
Learn more menu how it works: You register your products, organize them by category, and publish. When the guest opens the menu on their phone, they already see everything up to date — new price, item off for the day, special promotion. No printing, no risk of an outdated menu in the guest's hand.
Learn more menu advantage: Your menu becomes a professional storefront accessible from any phone, anywhere. A guest who already saw the menu before arriving knows what they want — and that speeds up service and raises the ticket.
Self order sales copy:
Pay by Phone — the guest pays on the spot, without waiting

When the check is done, the guest pays straight from the phone — no need to call the waiter, no waiting for the card machine, no line.

Less bottleneck at closing, more table turnover for you. And who paid, how much, and when stays fully recorded — nothing slips through, nothing disappears.
Learn more self order how it works: When the guest wants to close out, they open NeuraBar on the phone, see the table's consumption summary, and pay on the spot. The system confirms and the table is already available.
Learn more self order advantage: You do not depend on the waiter to close every table. The guest handles it, the payment is recorded, and you have exact control of everything that came in — by table, by time, with no surprise at the register.
Delivery sales copy:
Delivery and pickup orders — straight from the phone, no middlemen

Your customers open your up-to-date menu from any phone, anytime, and order directly from you — no calls, no mix-ups.

Best of all: you pay nothing per order. Unlike iFood and other apps, there is no delivery fee here. After a few orders, the activation pays for itself.
